caption: The drawing depicts a quilt-like square composition with a cream background, bordered by three stripes of blue, red, and blue. Within the bordered area are twenty-five individual, rectangular or circular panels arranged in a 5-by-5 grid. Each panel contains a distinct motif; many consist of circular floral wreaths featuring flowers in red, pink, yellow, blue, and green tones, accented by elements such as vases, baskets, birds, an anchor, and a heart. Some panels depict objects including a memorial obelisk, a yellow house, a ship with sails and American flags, a green tree with a lamb beneath it, an American flag with an eagle, and a cornucopia. The bouquets and objects are outlined and filled in shades of green, red, pink, yellow, blue, white, and brown, with the overall design rendered in fine detail and the individual motifs separated by lines of plain background fabric. The phrase “Worcester County” and the attribution “drawn by I. De Ste. Croix” are written at the bottom margin outside the border.
title: Friendship Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
